description: Test suite for store operations related to boards and blocks in the focalboard project, including creation, patching, deletion, and duplication of boards and blocks.

methods.name: StoreTestBoardsAndBlocksStore
methods.description: Runs a series of subtests for creating, patching, deleting, and duplicating boards and blocks in the store.

methods.name: testCreateBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests creation of boards and blocks, including success cases, failure cases, and size limit enforcement.

methods.name: testPatchBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests patching of boards and blocks, including success, failure, and size limit enforcement.

methods.name: testDeleteBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests deletion of boards and blocks, including cases with non-existent entities and proper cleanup.

methods.name: testDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Tests duplication of existing boards as templates or normal copies, including error handling for non-existent boards.
